desktop.figureName: Eye-level walking within a landscape with depth
desktop.figureDescription: Conceptual diagram, not campus geometry: a person stays upright on a connected path, with a reception and department in the middle distance and layered terrain and sky beyond. Ground behind and beside the visitor remains supported while the next area is prepared.
